Cape Verde Captain Ryan Mendes Faces Rape Allegation Investigation

Cape Verde captain Ryan Mendes is reportedly under investigation by New Zealand Police following an accusation of rape by a Brazilian interpreter. The alleged incident occurred in March 2026 when the interpreter claims Mendes entered her hotel room and assaulted her. The investigation is ongoing as the team prepares for a FIFA World Cup match.
